title: Photosynthesis and Nutrition
seo_title: Grade 6 Natural Sciences and Technology: Photosynthesis and Nutrition Worksheets (CAPS)
standard_code: Grade 6 Natural Sciences and Technology: Photosynthesis; nutrients in food; nutrition
standard_text: Green plants make their own food by photosynthesis using sunlight, water and carbon dioxide, and give off oxygen. People need nutrients in food: carbohydrates, proteins, fats, vitamins and minerals, plus water and fibre. A balanced diet keeps us healthy; poor nutrition causes disease. (summary of CAPS Natural Sciences and Technology, Grade 6, Life and Living: Photosynthesis; nutrients in food; nutrition)
meta_desc: Free Grade 6 Natural Sciences and Technology worksheets (CAPS): photosynthesis, food groups and nutrients, a balanced diet, and food processing. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: Plants make food from sunlight, water and carbon dioxide.
key_sub: A balanced diet has all the food groups.
body_html:
How to think about it

In photosynthesis, green leaves use sunlight to turn water and carbon dioxide into food (sugar and starch), and give off oxygen. Animals, including people, depend on this food.

Food gives us nutrients: carbohydrates (maize meal, bread) for energy, proteins (beans, eggs, meat) for growth, fats for stored energy, and vitamins and minerals (fruit and vegetables) for health. Too little protein can cause kwashiorkor. Food is processed (dried, cooked, salted, canned) so that it lasts longer.

Example

Which gas do plants take in for photosynthesis?

We breathe it out.

Answer: carbon dioxide

Example

Which nutrient do beans and eggs mainly give?

Needed for growth

Answer: protein

Common mistakes

  • Thinking plants get food from the soil.
  • Thinking fat should never be eaten.
  • Thinking processed food has no nutrients.

faq.q: Why is drying a way to preserve food?
faq.a: Bacteria and fungi need water to grow, so dry food spoils slowly.
Eating the right amounts from all the food groups, with water and fibre.

items.q: A plant makes food by photosynthesis. Which of these does it need?
items.e: A plant needs light, water, carbon dioxide and chlorophyll to make food. It does not need soil to make food.

items.q: Two identical chilli plants were kept for a week, one in light and one in the dark. Everything else was the same. Which plant made more food?
items.e: Light is needed for photosynthesis.

items.q: What food does a plant make during photosynthesis?
items.e: Plants make sugar. Some of it is stored as starch.

items.q: A plant has water, light and carbon dioxide. What else does it need to make food?
items.e: The four things needed for photosynthesis are light, water, carbon dioxide and chlorophyll.

items.q: Which part of most plants makes the most food?
items.e: They are green and flat, so they trap the most light.

items.e: Only one thing was different between the two plants: light.

to keep us healthy and help the body work properly

items.e: Protein: help the body grow and repair itself.
